_doc: Caption phrases, word for word ('|' separates on-screen phrases, Saisha-reel style). The taunts are shown as big highlight words instead of captions; their phrases are listed for timing only.
taunts: Hey, you loser! | You fatty dumbo! | Why do you always cry? | You crybaby?
familiar: Sounds familiar? | Maybe you have heard | these words growing up, | and you probably remember | how it felt.
imagine: And now imagine | if your child | is going through the same | and just not telling you | about it.
point: Sometimes children | don't tell us | that they are being bullied, | but little things | in their behaviour might.
signs: They'll suddenly tell you | that they don't feel like | going to school, | or they complain | of headaches or stomachache, | or suddenly become upset | or quiet or withdrawn, | or there are sudden changes | in the appetite | or sleep patterns.
balance: Of course, these signs | don't always mean bullying, | but if you notice them | repetitively, | don't brush them away.
ask: Instead of asking | "What's wrong with you?" | try asking, | "Is something bothering you? | Do you want to talk about it?"
listen: Sometimes a child | just needs to know | that somebody is there | to listen, | and that somebody | can be you.
